segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ יֵשׁ בָּא בִּיאָה אַחַת וְחַיָּיב עָלֶיהָ שֵׁשׁ חַטָּאוֹת, כֵּיצַד? הַבָּא עַל בִּתּוֹ חַיָּיב עָלֶיהָ מִשּׁוּם בִּתּוֹ, וַאֲחוֹתוֹ, אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו, וְאֵשֶׁת אֲחִי אָבִיו, וְאֵשֶׁת אִישׁ, וְנִדָּה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «There is» a case where «one» can «engage in a single» act of «intercourse and» be «liable» to bring «six sin offerings for it. How so?» It is possible for «one who engages in intercourse with his daughter» to be «liable due to» having violated the prohibitions of engaging in intercourse with «his daughter, his sister, the wife of his brother, the wife of his father’s brother, a married woman, and a menstruating woman.»

moves.summary: six sin offerings for one act

positions.claim: one who has relations with his daughter can be liable for daughter, sister, brother's wife, father's brother's wife, married woman and niddah
